display.purpose: Restaurant name at menu top, onboarding heroes. Phetsarath OT carries Lao equivalents.

headline.purpose: Menu category headers, dashboard section titles.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal headings, list item primary text.

body.purpose: Menu item descriptions, order details, flowing text. Line-height 1.6 required for Lao script.

label.purpose: Status indicators, table numbers, small metadata. Never uppercase-tracked.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Entrance animations, slide-up transitions. Spring-like settle without bounce.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Ambient background movement, decorative floating elements.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions — hover, focus, color changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action trigger. Near-black fill, white text, 10px radius. Darkens on hover; sinks 1px on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: Outfit, 'Noto Sans Lao', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. No fill at rest; Ghost Surface on hover. Used for cancel and non-destructive secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Outfit, 'Noto Sans Lao', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content container. Ring-only border, 14px radius, strict header/content/footer zones.
components.html:
ລາຍການ
ລາຍລະອຽດ

ເນື້ອຫາ

ດຳເນີນການ
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 16px 0 0 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-card-header { padding: 0 16px 12px 16px; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Outfit, 'Noto Sans Lao', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-description { font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 16px 16px; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.5); padding: 16px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field. Transparent fill, Hairline stroke, 10px radius. Focus shifts border to Focus Ash with a 3px ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="ຄົ້ນຫາ..." />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Outfit, 'Noto Sans Lao', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.5); opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Order Status Badge
components.description: Signature component. Four operationally distinct states (pending/confirmed/preparing/complete), differentiated by background color — never by shade alone.
components.html: ລໍຖ້າ ຮັບແລ້ວ ກຳລັງປຸງ ສຳເລັດ
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 18px; font-family: Outfit, 'Noto Sans Lao', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-pending { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-badge-confirmed { background: oklch(0.95 0.05 230); color: oklch(0.25 0.08 230); } .ds-badge-preparing { background: oklch(0.95 0.12 80); color: oklch(0.4 0.12 80); } .ds-badge-complete { background: oklch(0.95 0.05 145); color: oklch(0.35 0.1 145); }

narrative.overview:
A well-run kitchen doesn't waste motion. Every tool is where it belongs, every surface is clear, every action has a single obvious next step. Emenu carries that discipline into the digital — a product UI where operational clarity is the design. The Blackboard-and-Chalk palette is monochromatic by intent: zero visual noise means a cashier can read order state at a glance and a diner can find their dish without scanning through marketing. The brand color lives in --primary, injected per restaurant, so each tenant gets identity without the neutral system losing coherence.

Lao script is not an afterthought. Phetsarath OT handles headlines; Noto Sans Lao covers body copy; Outfit carries Latin characters at the same visual mass.

This system explicitly rejects delivery-app marketplace energy (UberEats, Foodpanda, GrabFood) and glassmorphism. Decoration that competes with the food is prohibited.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic zinc foundation — zero brand-color interference at the base layer
Flat tonal elevation — ring-borders and surface layering carry all depth
Lao-first typography — Phetsarath OT and Noto Sans Lao as primary weight-carriers
Tenant-injected accent — the system recedes; the restaurant brand advances
Dense but breathable layout — cashier needs density; diner needs whitespace

rules.name: The Slate Gray Floor Rule
rules.body: oklch(0.556 0 0) is the minimum lightness for any body text on Chalk White. Anything lighter fails 4.5:1. When in doubt, shift toward Deep Ink.

rules.name: The Tenant Accent Rule
rules.body: --primary is a reservation, not a committed color. Every affordance must survive replacement with any restaurant brand hue.

rules.name: The Lao Line Height Rule
rules.body: Lao script requires line-height: 1.6 minimum. Never go below 1.5 for any Lao copy.

rules.name: The Phetsarath Ceiling
rules.body: Use Phetsarath OT only at headline and display sizes (≥1rem). Noto Sans Lao below that boundary.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow with blur > 0 on any component at rest. Hover states may add a soft ambient shadow for interactive elements only.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Card boundaries use box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1), not border.

dos: Do use box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1) as the card boundary. Not border.
Do keep muted foreground at ≥ oklch(0.556 0 0) for any body text on Chalk White.
Do set Lao script body text at line-height: 1.6 minimum.
Do design every affordance to work with any --primary value.
Do use Phetsarath OT for Lao at ≥1rem; Noto Sans Lao below that.
Do reserve Kitchen Red for destructive and error states only.
Do differentiate order status badges by background color, not shade.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent on cards or list items.
Don't use delivery-app UI patterns: promotional banners, gamified badges, carousel-first layouts.
Don't use generic white-label SaaS scaffolding forgettable across any product.
Don't use glassmorphism: blurred hero images behind menus, frosted-glass card treatments.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Solid color always.
Don't tint the neutral base warm or cool by default. Warmth comes from --primary.
Don't use tracked uppercase eyebrow labels or numbered section markers (01 · 02 · 03).
Don't use arbitrary z-index values (999, 9999). Use semantic scale.
